meta.name: screen-reader-testing
meta.description: Test web applications with screen readers including VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS. Use when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging accessibility issues, or ensuring assistive technology support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试网页对读屏软件的兼容性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在测试网站的无障碍支持，需要验证读屏兼容性。
copy.tagline_en: Test web compatibility with screen readers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your web app works with screen readers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会依据屏幕阅读器(VoiceOver、NVDA、JAWS 等)给出设置方法、快捷键、测试步骤和检查清单,并针对表单、动态内容、模态框等场景提供 HTML 修复示例。
howto.when: 当验证屏幕阅读器兼容性、调试无障碍问题,或测试 ARIA、表单、动态播报、导航等可访问性时触发。

say.text: 用 VoiceOver 检查这个页面的标题和地标是否正常播报
say.note: Claude 会给出 VoiceOver 测试步骤和检查项。

say.text: 帮我写一个 NVDA 测试脚本,测表单错误提示
say.note: Claude 会列出 NVDA 流程和表单错误检查点。

say.text: 这个弹窗焦点没困住,怎么修?
say.note: Claude 会给出模态框聚焦管理和修复代码。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude provides setup, shortcuts, test steps, and checklists for screen readers (VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS, etc.), plus HTML fix examples for forms, dynamic content, modals, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging accessibility issues, or testing ARIA, forms, dynamic announcements, and navigation accessibility.

say_en.text: Use VoiceOver to check if the page title and landmarks are announced properly
say_en.note: Claude provides VoiceOver test steps and checklist.

say_en.text: Write an NVDA test script for form error messages
say_en.note: Claude lists NVDA flow and form error checks.

say_en.text: Focus is not trapped in this modal. How to fix?
say_en.note: Claude provides modal focus management and fix code.
